  {fd : LowIR.Prog.FunDef} {args : List Rv64i.Word}
  {sp0 : Rv64i.Word} {fuel : Nat} {s' : LowIR.ProgSim.St}
  {L : LowIR.ProgSim.Layout} {m0 : Rv64i.State},
  List.lookup entry P.env = some fd →
    LowIR.ProgSim.layoutOf P entry L.codeBase L.stackLo =
        some L →
      LowIR.ProgSim.SimPre L L.stackLo sp0 →
        m0.pc = L.codeBase →
          m0.rget 2 = sp0 →
            args.length = fd.argc →
              (∀ (i : Nat),
                  i < fd.argc →
                    m0.rget (10 + i) = args.getD i 0) →
                LowIR.ProgSim.Installed L m0 →
                  (∀ (g : LowIR.Prog.Name)
                      (gd : LowIR.Prog.FunDef),
                      List.lookup g P.env = some gd →
                        LowIR.ProgSim.BranchOk gd.body) →
                    (∀ (st0 : LowIR.Prog.St),
                        LowIR.Prog.frameEnter L.stackLo fd
                              (LowIR.ProgSim.userPad P.env
                                entry)
                              args
                              (LowIR.Prog.installData
                                (L.codeBase +
                                  BitVec.ofNat 64
                                    L.segStart)
                                P.data fun x => 0)
                              sp0 =
                            some st0 →
                          LowIR.ProgSim.MemAccOff L
                            [(st0.sp,
                                LowIR.Compile.userOff fd)]
                            P
                            (LowIR.Prog.dbaseOf
                              (L.codeBase +
                                BitVec.ofNat 64 L.segStart)
                              P.data)
                            (LowIR.ProgSim.userPad P.env)
                            L.stackLo fuel fd.body st0) →
                      (∀ (a : Rv64i.Word),
                          ¬LowIR.ProgSim.MachPriv L [] a →
                            LowIR.Prog.installData
                                (L.codeBase +
                                  BitVec.ofNat 64
                                    L.segStart)
                                P.data (fun x => 0) a =
                              m0.mem a) →
                        LowIR.Prog.run P L.stackLo fuel
                              entry args (fun x => 0) sp0
                              (LowIR.ProgSim.userPad P.env)
                              (L.codeBase +
                                BitVec.ofNat 64
                                  L.segStart) =
                            some s' →
                          ∃ k,
                            (Rv64i.runFuel L.haltPc k
                                    m0).pc =
                                L.haltPc ∧
                              (∀ (j : Nat),
                                  j < fd.rvc →
                                    (Rv64i.runFuel L.haltPc
                                            k m0).rget
                                        (10 + j) =
                                      LowIR.Prog.St.rget s'
                                        (fd.rets.toList.getD
                                          j 0)) ∧
                                ∀ (a : Rv64i.Word),
                                  ¬LowIR.ProgSim.memRange a
                                        L.codeBase
                                        L.blobLen →
                                    ¬LowIR.ProgSim.MachStack
                                          L.stackLo sp0 a →
                                      s'.mem a =
                                        (Rv64i.runFuel
                                              L.haltPc k
                                              m0).mem
                                          a

  (argVals : List Rv64i.Word) (p : Nat),
  m.pc = L.codeBase + BitVec.ofNat 64 p →
    LowIR.ProgSim.Emitted L p (LowIR.ProgSim.prologueI fd) →
      LowIR.ProgSim.Installed L m →
        m.rget LowIR.Compile.SP = sp0 →
          m.rget LowIR.Compile.RA = ra →
            (∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < argVals.length),
                m.rget (LowIR.Compile.A i) = argVals[i]) →
              fd.params.toList.length = argVals.length →
                (∀ (x : LowIR.Prog.Reg),
                    x ∈ fd.params.toList →
                      x ≤ LowIR.Compile.maxRegF fd) →
                  fd.frameReg ≤ LowIR.Compile.maxRegF fd →
                    callee.sp =
                        sp0 -
                          BitVec.ofNat 64
                            (LowIR.Compile.totalFrame fd) →
                      (∀ (r : LowIR.Prog.Reg),
                          1 ≤ r →
                            LowIR.Prog.St.rget callee r =
                              if r = fd.frameReg then
                                sp0 -
                                  BitVec.ofNat 64
                                    fd.frameSize
                              else
                                LowIR.ProgSim.parkFold
                                  (fun x => 0)
                                  (fd.params.toList.zip
                                    argVals)
                                  r) →
                        (∀ (a : Rv64i.Word),
                            LowIR.ProgSim.OffPriv L
                                ((callee.sp,

                                      fd) ::
                                  holes)
                                callee.sp a →

                                    (callee.sp +

                                        (LowIR.Compile.userOff
                                          fd))
                                    fd.frameSize →
                                callee.mem a = m.mem a) →
                          (∀ (a : Rv64i.Word),
                              LowIR.ProgSim.memRange a
                                  (callee.sp +
                                    BitVec.ofNat 64
                                      (LowIR.Compile.userOff
                                        fd))
                                  fd.frameSize →
                                callee.mem a = 0) →
                            LowIR.Compile.totalFrame fd ≤
                                2000 →
                              fd.frameSize % 8 = 0 →
                                BitVec.toNat sp0 % 8 = 0 →
                                  LowIR.Compile.totalFrame
                                        fd ≤
                                      BitVec.toNat sp0 →
                                    4 * L.instrs.length ≤
                                        L.segStart →
                                      BitVec.toNat
                                              L.codeBase +
                                            L.blobLen ≤
                                          2 ^ 64 →
                                        BitVec.toNat
                                                  L.codeBase +
                                                L.blobLen ≤
                                              BitVec.toNat
                                                callee.sp ∨
                                            BitVec.toNat
                                                  callee.sp +
                                                LowIR.Compile.userOff
                                                  fd ≤
                                              BitVec.toNat
                                                L.codeBase →
                                          BitVec.toNat
                                                    L.codeBase +
                                                  L.blobLen ≤
                                                BitVec.toNat
                                                  callee.sp ∨
                                              BitVec.toNat
                                                    callee.sp +
                                                  LowIR.Compile.totalFrame
                                                    fd ≤
                                                BitVec.toNat
                                                  L.codeBase →
                                            (∀

                                                  LowIR.ProgSim.Hole),
                                                h ∈ holes →
                                                  BitVec.toNat
                                                      sp0 ≤
                                                    BitVec.toNat
                                                      h.fst) →
                                              (∀
                                                  (h :
                                                    LowIR.ProgSim.Hole),
                                                  h ∈
                                                      holes →
                                                    BitVec.toNat
                                                          h.fst +
                                                        h.snd ≤
                                                      2 ^
                                                        64) →
                                                8 ≤ p →
                                                  p +
                                                        4 *
                                                          LowIR.ProgSim.prologueSize
                                                            fd <
                                                      2 ^
                                                        20 →
                                                    ∃ k,
                                                      LowIR.ProgSim.StInv
                                                          L
                                                          fd
                                                          ((callee.sp,
                                                              LowIR.Compile.userOff
                                                                fd) ::
                                                            holes)
                                                          callee
                                                          (LowIR.ProgSim.stepN
                                                            k
                                                            m) ∧
                                                        (LowIR.ProgSim.stepN
                                                                k
                                                                m).pc =
                                                            L.codeBase +
                                                              BitVec.ofNat
                                                                64
                                                                (p +
                                                                  4 *
                                                                    LowIR.ProgSim.prologueSize
                                                                      fd) ∧
                                                          (LowIR.ProgSim.stepN
                                                                    k
                                                                    m).loadWord
                                                                callee.sp =

                                                                      a
                                                                      callee.sp
                                                                      (LowIR.Compile.totalFrame
                                                                        fd) →
                                                                  (LowIR.ProgSim.stepN
                                                                          k
                                                                          m).mem

                                                                k

  (oc : LowIR.Ctrl.Outcome) (m : Rv64i.State) (here : Nat)
  (brkPos contPos : List Nat),
  LowIR.Prog.exec P dbase pad stackLo fuel stmt s =
      some (s', oc) →
    LowIR.ProgSim.StInv L fd holes s m →
      m.pc = L.codeBase + BitVec.ofNat 64 here →
        LowIR.ProgSim.Emitted L here

          LowIR.Compile.maxRegS stmt ≤
              LowIR.Compile.maxRegF fd →
            BitVec.toNat s.sp + LowIR.Compile.userOff fd ≤
                2 ^ 64 →
              BitVec.toNat L.codeBase + L.blobLen ≤
                      BitVec.toNat stackLo ∧
                    BitVec.toNat stackLo ≤
                      BitVec.toNat s.sp ∨
                  BitVec.toNat s.sp +
                      LowIR.Compile.userOff fd ≤
                    BitVec.toNat L.codeBase →
                LowIR.ProgSim.MemAccOff L holes P dbase pad
                    stackLo fuel stmt s →
                  LowIR.ProgSim.LabelsOk brkPos contPos
                      epiPos →
                    here + 4 * LowIR.ProgSim.csize stmt <
                        2 ^ 20 →
                      LowIR.ProgSim.BranchOk stmt →
                        LowIR.Compile.userOff fd ≤ 2000 →
                          here % 4 = 0 →
                            8 ≤ here →
                              4 * L.instrs.length ≤
                                  L.segStart →
                                BitVec.toNat L.codeBase +
                                      L.blobLen ≤

                                          LowIR.ProgSim.synthHi

                                                        fd →

                                                            k

                                                            64
                                                            (LowIR.Compile.slotOff
                                                              target)) =
